title: [Payables Agent] Exclude agent accounts from eligible users
summary: Payables Agent Setup now excludes users with Agent license type from the eligible invoice creator list to prevent access-control errors when agent accounts create posted invoices.
key_points: Agent license type users are filtered out from automatic user selection
Preserves existing non-agent user eligibility criteria
Maintains 30-day invoice creation window for non-agent users
Prevents platform rejection of access-control entries
Updated procedure documentation to reflect non-agent restriction
